description: Void-of-course Moon at a moment: whether the Moon makes no further Ptolemaic aspect to a traditional planet (Sun..Saturn) before it leaves its current sign. Returns the Moon's sign, the UTC time it exits that sign, and the UTC time of its next perfecting aspect (null when none remains -- i.e. void). Tropical by default.
